title: Reach conformance matrix v1
description: The matrix of the reach conformance suite (docs/reach-matrix.md): for each harness run over each fixture repository, the state each guidance file was observed in, per reach scenario, next to what the harness's vendor documentation says (reach_conformance.v1). One matrix is written per harness and several are merged into one. A `skipped` run has no cells; a cell whose documented state is `unknown` makes no claim.

run_id.description: The envelope: the id of the run that saved this file (dokimi.artifacts.run_id). Absent from files saved before the envelope.

dokimi_version.description: The envelope: the dokimi version that saved this file. Absent from files saved before the envelope.

expectations.description: The schema of the expectations file the documented states come from.

expectations_digest.description: The sha256 of the expectations file's content as canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces); matrices with different digests are not merged.

fixtures_digest.description: The sha256 of the fixture tree the runs observed (each file's relative path and bytes, a link's target); matrices with different digests are not merged.

version.description: The harness's own version as reach reports it; `unknown` when no receipt came back.

model.description: The model string passed to the harness; empty when none was configured.

status.description: ran: every scenario answered; errors: a receipt came back with at least one scenario that gave no usable answer; failed: no usable receipt, or no scenario answered; skipped: the harness could not run here.

alias_of.description: Set when the path is a link; its observed state is the target's.

agreement.description: agrees and disagrees compare observed with documented; inconclusive: observed is unknown or fetched; no_claim: the docs say nothing; alias: a link, not compared.
